# Pickleball Platform — AI Navigation Index

This file acts as a structural index and entry point for LLMs, AI coding assistants, and developers to explore the technical state, business logic, and API schemas of the Pickleball Booking Platform.

---

## 1. Documentation Index Directories

* **Product Index**: Refer to [docs/00-INDEX.md](docs/00-INDEX.md) for human-readable product requirements and business setup checklists.
* **Technical Index**: Refer to [docs/ai/00-INDEX.md](docs/ai/00-INDEX.md) for AI-readable codebase maps, active statuses, and dev guides.

---

## 2. Directory Structure Map

All technical context, architecture maps, and schemas are located in the repository under `docs/ai/`.

| File | Relative Path | Purpose |
|:---|:---|:---|
| **Project Context** | [docs/ai/01-PROJECT-CONTEXT.md](docs/ai/01-PROJECT-CONTEXT.md) | Business goals, Besa Nagpur scope, customer & staff user flows. |
| **Architecture** | [docs/ai/02-ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ai/02-ARCHITECTURE.md) | Headless design (Next.js + Express + Postgres) & deployment model. |
| **Business Rules** | [docs/ai/03-BUSINESS-RULES.md](docs/ai/03-BUSINESS-RULES.md) | State transitions, Pricing waterfall rules, and RBAC matrix. |
| **Database Schema** | [docs/ai/04-DATABASE.md](docs/ai/04-DATABASE.md) | Prisma mappings, indexes, venue-tenant structure, and schema diagrams. |
| **API Directory** | [docs/ai/05-API/](docs/ai/05-API/) | Directory containing modular endpoint definitions and authentication. |
| **Frontend Layout** | [docs/ai/06-FRONTEND.md](docs/ai/06-FRONTEND.md) | Next.js route groups, proxy.js matchers, styling rules, and variables. |
| **Backend Modules** | [docs/ai/07-BACKEND.md](docs/ai/07-BACKEND.md) | Express app structure, module divisions, and middleware pipelines. |
| **Integrations** | [docs/ai/08-INTEGRATIONS.md](docs/ai/08-INTEGRATIONS.md) | PhonePe PG webhooks & Meta WhatsApp OTP configurations. |
| **Development Guide**| [docs/ai/09-DEVELOPMENT-GUIDE.md](docs/ai/09-DEVELOPMENT-GUIDE.md) | Run scripts, testing suites, migrations, seed setups, and env vars. |
| **Implementation Status**| [docs/ai/10-IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md](docs/ai/10-IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md) | Implemented, Partially Implemented, Planned, and Blocked features. |
| **Active Issues** | [docs/ai/11-ACTIVE-ISSUES.md](docs/ai/11-ACTIVE-ISSUES.md) | Active bugs, failing test descriptions, and runtime anomalies. |
| **Technical Debt** | [docs/ai/12-TECHNICAL-DEBT-AND-DEFERRED-WORK.md](docs/ai/12-TECHNICAL-DEBT-AND-DEFERRED-WORK.md) | Technical debt, stubs, and work deferred beyond the MVP. |
| **Decision History** | [docs/ai/13-DECISION-HISTORY.md](docs/ai/13-DECISION-HISTORY.md) | ADR summary table and reference links. |
| **Maintenance Rules** | [docs/ai/14-MAINTENANCE-RULES.md](docs/ai/14-MAINTENANCE-RULES.md) | The strict change matrix and completion checklist. |

---

## 3. Core Repository Hierarchy Rules

1. **Codebase (`/server`, `/web`)**: The absolute source of truth for what is actually implemented and running.
2. **AI Docs (`/docs/ai`)**: The source of truth for the codebase's current technical architecture and implementation state.
3. **Product Docs (`/docs`)**: The source of truth for target product intent, business requirements, and specifications.
4. **ADRs (`/docs/adrs`)**: The source of truth for historical decisions and technical rationale.

---

## 4. Quick Start (Onboarding)
* Refer to [docs/ai/09-DEVELOPMENT-GUIDE.md](docs/ai/09-DEVELOPMENT-GUIDE.md) to launch the dev environment, run the database migrations, and execute tests.
* Refer to [docs/ai/10-IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md](docs/ai/10-IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md) to inspect the current state of features before starting code modifications.
